diagnosis: CrossSessionToastPollingView allows client polling of pending UI toast messages by providing a session_key parameter. The view instantiates SessionStore(session_key=target_session_key) and unpacks messages stored under SessionStorage.session_key without verifying that target_session_key belongs to request.session. In applications that place temporary credentials, one-time unlock tokens, or sensitive account notices into messages, an attacker can extract sensitive flash data from other active user sessions.
